Upstream: gpui-pre-wgpu 0.3.9, Apache-2.0
Zed snapshot: 93d745668805029476e6d7fbb19652116fed51de

Local patch: prefer OpenGL when CPU adapters present desktop windows.
An unmodified OpenCap package remained blank with Mesa software Vulkan in
Xvfb but rendered its complete UI with software OpenGL in the same runtime.
Hardware adapters retain their original ranking, as do headless contexts.
Four metadata-only selection tests cover these policy boundaries.

Retain LICENSE-APACHE. Other source matches the crates.io snapshot.
